dogecoin.text:
One of many signs we are in a bubble... I believe one that will be worse than the dot com bubble. This sort of thing is totally ridiculous, along with Dogecoin, and all the other nonsense happening (Tesla, GameStop, etc.). 

Someone has to point out the emperor has no clothes. 🙋🏻‍♂️

@tonyistoomuch Very true. But those same rulers can say “transacting BTC or ETH” is illegal. That will out a damper on its usefulness and value. 

I do think cryptocurrencies around something specific/useful (like ETH, LBRY, IPFS) are more likely to survive restrictions than BTC or Dogecoin.
